results.text: Vonoprazan Versus Lansoprazole in the Healing and Maintenance Phase of Erosive Esophagitis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials. Vonoprazan (VPZ), a potassium-competitive acid blocker, has emerged as an alternative to traditional proton-pump inhibitors like Lansoprazole (LPZ) for the treatment of erosive esophagitis (EE).
